status: Accepted Sep 2026 · to be presented Dec 12–16, 2026, San Francisco
summary: We propose the first oxide-semiconductor dual-gate polarization-boosted charge-trapping flash, with a comprehensive model coupling antiferroelectric polarization switching, tunneling, and charge trapping. The device achieves a 10.3 V memory window under ±13 V operation, keeps 6.9 V after 10^5 program/erase cycles, and shows projected 10-year retention.
title: First Demonstration of Oxide-Semiconductor Dual-Gate Polarization-Boosted Charge-Trapping Flash: Comprehensive Modeling and Experimental Validation
